subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should active-provider quota windows be fetched and displayed on each eligible reply, and should that behavior apply only to `/usage full` or also to `/usage tokens`?
rationale: Current policy intentionally keeps provider quotas in `/status`, and moving them into every reply changes network frequency, latency, footer density, and credential-scoping requirements; repository evidence cannot choose those product tradeoffs.

options.title: Full mode, credential-scoped
options.body: Show cached, timeout-bounded quota windows only in `/usage full`, tied to the exact active credential/profile and omitted on lookup failure.

options.title: Both usage modes
options.body: Show quota windows in `/usage tokens` and `/usage full`, accepting a denser tokens mode and broader per-reply polling surface.

options.title: Keep status-only
options.body: Retain provider quota exclusively in `/status` and keep reply footers limited to per-turn accounting.

recommendation.title: Full mode, credential-scoped
recommendation.body: Show cached, timeout-bounded quota windows only in `/usage full`, tied to the exact active credential/profile and omitted on lookup failure.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and repaired the exact usage-state/footer boundary, including the deliberate removal of unsafe provider-limit correlation.
